headline: 今日新片齐上映，末日地堡热度领跑
headlineEn: New films open today; Doomsday Bunker leads trending
summary: 2026-08-21电影市场活跃：今日3部新片上映，本周共6部。今日热度由《末日地堡》《怒之杀》等领跑；本周《绿灯军团》最受关注，《玩具总动员5》亦持续热门。下一部值得关注的是《最后的日出》。
summaryEn: On 2026-08-21 the film market is active: 3 new titles open today, 6 this week. Today's buzz is led by Doomsday Bunker and Rage Kill; Green Lantern Corps tops weekly attention, while Toy Story 5 also remains hot. Next up is The Last Sunrise.

industryHighlights.text: 今日3部电影上映，本周新片总数达6部。
industryHighlights.en: 3 movies opened today, with 6 new films this week.
Doomsday Bunker tops today's trending charts.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》领跑本周热度，超英题材受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps leads weekly trends, superhero theme draws attention.

industryHighlights.text: 动画续作《玩具总动员5》本周持续上榜。
industryHighlights.en: Toy Story 5 remains on weekly charts as a popular animated sequel.

industryHighlights.text: 备受期待的《最后的日出》即将上映。
industryHighlights.en: Highly anticipated The Last Sunrise is coming soon.
